│ Operations:
│ • Enqueue: O(1) append to tail
│ • Dequeue (head): O(1) remove head
│ • Cancel: O(1) unlink node (needs pointer to node)
│ • Peek head: O(1)
│ • Count: O(1) cached
│ • Iterate: O(N) for timeout checks
